architecture.data_flow: Student selects items from pastel-product-card grid -> updates local reactive cart state -> dispatches POST to /api/orders with JSON payload -> server persists order (Redis / memory fallback) and issues queue number -> client renders QR code confirmation and polls /api/orders for live status updates
architecture.state_management: Local reactive cart store synchronized with localStorage (kantin_orders, kantin_counter, kantin_last_order_id) and optimistic UI updates with polling fallback (1.5s)

motion_lifecycle.entry: CSS @keyframes float and float-diagonal with staggered animation-delay
motion_lifecycle.unmount_cleanup: DOM animations bound to CSS; clear active intervals on window unload

breaking_scenarios.vector: Network disconnection or HTTP 504 during checkout mutation POST /api/orders
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Catch fetch failure, persist pending order in localStorage queue, display non-blocking offline banner with retry button, prevent cart wipe until confirmed

breaking_scenarios.vector: Zero menu items returned from server or network unreachable on initial page load
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Render graceful empty state using fallback catalog with cached items from localStorage, preventing blank screen or JavaScript crash

breaking_scenarios.vector: Order note exceeding 300 characters or rapid double-click on order submission
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Text area enforces maxlength='300' with visual character counter; submission button disables immediately with isPending flag and debounce

breaking_scenarios.vector: Client browser lacks WebGL support or GPU context crashes
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Graceful static CSS gradient fallback (.sky-bg linear gradient from #87CEEB to #E3F2FD) without three.js canvas error
CSS media query disables float, drift, and pulse animations, fixing positions statically
